summary: Loads a custom POP operator implemented as a C++ plugin. It is the native-extension path for custom POP behavior and plugin-side access to POP data.
key_concepts: Custom POP operator implemented as a C++ plugin
Plugin Path resolves the native extension to load
Re-Init recreates the plugin class instance
Unload Plugin releases shared plugin instances only after all users unload
common_gotchas: Plugin lifecycle matters; multiple operators using the same plugin may all need to unload before the file is released.
Use CPlusPlus POP only when built-in POPs or GLSL POPs are not sufficient.
Recent builds added cross-family CUDA buffer access, so confirm build compatibility for GPU interop work.
